name: SSVDAG Node Layout and Tagged Pointer Encoding
definition: A node layout for Sparse Voxel DAGs that uses variable-length tagged pointers to reduce memory consumption by encoding child pointers with 2 or 4 bytes instead of a fixed size, while storing transformation codes in the header.
summary: SSVDAG Node Layout and Tagged Pointer Encoding minimizes memory by replacing fixed pointers with variable-length tagged pointers that embed transformation codes for GPU-friendly traversal.
